note: EkGuru's level ladder, in the exact order levels appear everywhere on the site: A1 A2 A3 B1 B2 B3 C1 C2 C3 C4 C5. A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 and C2 are the six official CEFR levels and carry the full authored content of each course. A3, B3, C3, C4 and C5 are EkGuru Extended Mastery levels — EkGuru's own extension beyond the CEFR scale, which stops at C2. They are never described as official CEFR and are published for a course only when their content has been authored. Age is not a level: a learner of any age can study any level, and nothing on the site treats a level as belonging to an age group. (v2 replaces the v1 A1+ half-step ladder and its age-staged figures; see data/audit/retire-fake-courses.json for the retirement of the placeholder content that used to fill A3-C5.)

extended_note: A3, B3, C3, C4 and C5 are EkGuru Extended Mastery levels. They are not part of the official CEFR, which has exactly six levels: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2. A course publishes an extended level only when its full content has been authored; until then the level is shown as in development and nothing is claimed about it.
